description: January 8 birthday meaning: Capricorn decan 2, birthday number 8, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a January 8 birthday falls in Capricorn, in the second decan, with Saturn as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 8. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Capricorn is cardinal and earth.

sections.heading: January 8 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Few dates stack authority as neatly as January 8. Eight is numerology's number of power, management and material results, and Capricorn, ruled by Saturn, is traditionally the zodiac's executive. About seventeen degrees into the sign, the Venus decan adds a sense of proportion, so ambition tends to come wrapped in good manners rather than bluster.

On January 8 the Sun usually sits at about 17° Capricorn, in the second decan, where Venus is the sub-ruler alongside Saturn. In the middle of Capricorn, from 10 to 19 degrees, Venus acts as sub-ruler, borrowed from Taurus. Birthdays from about January 1 to January 10 tend to soften the Goat's seriousness with an appreciation of comfort, quality and beauty. These Capricorns are often pictured as both ambitious and sensual: they want to build something, and they want it well made and pleasant to live with. Loyalty in relationships is usually strong. Venus can make material security feel especially important. Remembering that enjoyment is part of success, not a reward postponed for later, often brings this decan balance.

sections.heading: January 8 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 8th gives a birthday number of 8 with nothing to reduce. In numerology the day of birth works as a supporting number, a practical aptitude that colours the Life Path. The 8, drawn as two stacked loops, is traditionally linked with balance between the material and inner worlds, and with authority, organisation and ambition. People born on the 8th are often seen as capable managers of money, time and teams. They may also be hard on themselves when results lag. Generosity with the influence they build is commonly regarded as the 8's best expression.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one January 8 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on January 8: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 8 is the 8th day of the year. By January 21, 13 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Aquarius.

For the Chinese zodiac, January 8 always falls before Lunar New Year, which arrives between January 21 and February 20, so someone born on this date takes the animal of the previous calendar year. Well-known people born on January 8 include Elvis Presley (1935), Stephen Hawking (1942) and David Bowie (1947).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 8?
faq.answer: January 8 is Capricorn in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Capricorn, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 8?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 8 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 8 for everyone born on the 8th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 8?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology counts the year from Lunar New Year, never earlier than January 21, so a January 8 birthday belongs to the animal of the year before the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 8?
faq.answer: January 8 is also the birthday of Elvis Presley (1935), Stephen Hawking (1942) and David Bowie (1947). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
